newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybean basis values up.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Corn and soybean basis values up.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf corn and soybean basis values were higher Friday in reaction to tight supplies in market channels and news that China may have bought at least one cargo of soybeans, grain dealers said.

U.S. exporters said China appeared to have bought at least one cargo of U.S. soybeans and possibly two more Thursday night for May/June delivery. One exporter said the one cargo was about 50,000 to 55,000 tonnes.
Corn values rose in reaction to light farmer selling.
Clear weather this week in the Midwest had many farmers concentrating on spring planting rather than selling grain.
Winter wheat basis values were unchanged.
